input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Crazy World"?

documents.text: After feeling it was "disingenuous" to the band, they scrapped it. According to Martin Johnson, the album originally leaned into an electro-pop hybrid sound and "didn't really feel like The Beatles." [2] Johnson retreated to Nashville, writing with other musicians and creating demos that "didn't have a specific purpose." [2] During that time span, he wrote 300 songs and believed a The Beatles album was hiding in there somewhere and sent the members about 24 tracks. [2]
